verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a RESTful Gmail API with human-readable reference pages, such as the messages.send endpoint, but nothing in the pack shows a downloadable machine-readable spec (OpenAPI or equivalent). The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, so this applicable capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
